description: Events the platform refused or could not store, newest first. This is a report: the events themselves are not kept here, and fixing the cause is what lets the device's next events through.
deviceCallout_one: {{count}} event from this device was rejected in the last 24 hours.
deviceCallout_other: {{count}} events from this device were rejected in the last 24 hours.
empty: No refused events match. A device whose data is missing for another reason is not listed here.
notPermitted: Ingest failures are shown to members who manage devices (device:write).
payloadExpired: The original event is no longer held; only this summary remains.
reasonHint_API_CALL_FAILED: A platform service the event needed could not be reached, or storing the event failed.
reasonHint_DEVICE_DISABLED: The device exists and has been disabled.
reasonHint_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: No device has the token the sender named. Register the device or correct the token it sends.
reasonHint_INTEGRATION_ALIAS_MISMATCH: An integration's event named a device that no longer holds the alias it was matched by.
reasonHint_INVALID: The message could not be read at all. Check the payload format the device sends.
reasonHint_NOT_GATEWAY_CHILD: A gateway published for a device that is not assigned to it, or that does not exist.
reasonHint_UNAUTHENTICATED: The credential the device presented was missing or wrong. Check the device's credential.
reasonHint_UNKNOWN: A reason this version of the console does not name. The reason code is shown on the row.
suppressedHint: At most 10 records per device and reason are kept each hour; this many more were counted on this row.
title: Ingest failures
